Sep 17, 2019 #2

connector.land seeks to be adopted

For moneyd-uplinks-(xrp|eth) there is a list of connectors that allow moneyd instances to connect to them as children:

  • connector_list.json for moneyd-uplink-xrp
  • connector_list.json for moneyd-uplink-eth

When you configure these uplinks, moneyd will choose one at random.
